text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, Nakayama Festa is reading
some fan
mail she's received.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ha, look at these,
Trainer. Isn't it crazy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I read the letters she hands me. The
senders are a
mix of ages, ranging from
kids to adults.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I get so excited when watching you
run."
"Make your next race another
heated one."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every single letter is filled with
excitement,
requesting her to keep the
fire burning.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Sheesh... Can you believe it? These are
actually
pumping me up.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. They say like-minded people are
drawn to
each other. Guess I should be
happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa turns to look out the
window.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's still time, no? The sky's a pretty
nice color
too.
choice_data_list: Wait, you're going for a run now?
Wait, you're going for a run now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look out the window at the sky, which
has turned
a deep red. It's a color that
evokes heat.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer. We've got a fire to
start.
